_key.description: Variant key, Ensembl protein ID and the GVATdb experiment identifier with dots rewritten to underscores, joined by underscores.

p_value.description: Monte-Carlo p-value of the preferential binding score.

p_value_adj.description: FDR of the preferential binding score.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log10 of the PBS p-value. Capped at 5 when the reported p-value is 0.

hg19_coordinate.description: hg19 coordinates of the 40-bp oligo used in SNP-SELEX.

oligo_auc.description: Oligo binding score: area under the SELEX enrichment curve for the 40-bp oligo, regardless of allele. Larger values mean stronger TF binding to the oligo.

oligo_pval.description: P-value of the oligo binding score.

ref_auc.description: Area under the SELEX enrichment curve for the reference allele.

alt_auc.description: Area under the SELEX enrichment curve for the alternate allele.

pbs.description: Preferential binding score: area between the reference and alternate enrichment curves. Negative values mean the TF prefers the alternate allele.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Negative log10 of the FDR. Set to 2 when the reported FDR is 0.

biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for regulation of DNA binding, as a handle into ontology_terms.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this SNP-SELEX table was read from.

accessible_via.name: variants_proteins
accessible_via.return: label, method, class, source, source_url, neg_log10_pvalue_adj, p_value, neg_log10_pvalue, files_filesets
